header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This
body: petition was filed by the petitioner with prayer that directions be issued to the respondents to construct the school building at the desired /facility of the majority of the villagers. Construction of a school is policy matter of the Government; however, if there is genuine grievance of the petitioner, the same be redressed by the Secretary, Education Government of Sindh, on an application filed by the petitioner. In view of the above, the instant petition stands disposed of.
